home.title: Find suppliers
home.lead: Describe the goods or services in your own words. LOTIVE picks out the items and suggests companies, with sources and checks for each one.

box.label: Describe what you need
box.placeholder: For example: buckwheat groats 500 kg; polished rice 200 kg
box.hint: Enter to search, Shift+Enter for a new line

example.groats: Buckwheat groats 500 kg; polished rice 200 kg
example.office: Office paper A4 80 gsm, 300 reams; blue ballpoint pens, 500 pcs
example.medical: Nitrile examination gloves size M, 2000 pairs; three-layer medical masks, 5000 pcs

box.progress: Picking out the items and looking for companies…

items.title: Items
items.hint: Choose an item to keep only the candidates that cover it.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.noMatch: No candidate has records for this item.

warning.title: Results may be incomplete
warning.channelFailed: One of the search channels did not answer, so some companies may be missing.
warning.enrichmentFailed: Some company details could not be loaded. Affected candidates are marked for checking.
warning.archiveFailed: The search was not saved: the link will not open later.
warning.itemsInferred: Some items were added by the system. Confirm them before contacting suppliers.

evidence.matchesHint: The match comes from catalogs and price lists, not from warehouse stock.
evidence.historyNote: Past participation and wins do not guarantee a future delivery.
evidence.noveltyNew: The INN is absent from the source supplier archive (set {{set}}).
evidence.noveltyKnown: The INN is present in the source supplier archive (set {{set}}).
evidence.noveltyUnknown: Novelty cannot be established: no verifiable INN or the archive set is not loaded.
evidence.nameRegistry: Taken from the FNS SME registry by the exact INN.
evidence.nameMissing: No name was found in the sources or the registry; the INN is shown.

empty.title: No suppliers found
empty.text: Nothing in the available records matches these items. Try naming the goods more generally, without brands and sizes, or put each item on its own line.

missing.title: Search not found
missing.text: The link is outdated, or the search was made in another browser.

guide.title: How to read a result
guide.stock: There is a price list or stock record with a source and a check date.
guide.catalog: The product is in the company catalog; availability needs confirming.
guide.inferred: There is no direct source, the system inferred it — check before contacting.
guide.none: The company has no records about this item.
guide.decision: The decision stays with you: mark suitable candidates and download them as a CSV file.

inputs.ignored: Provided but not used by the current model (text mode): {{fields}}.

coverage.title: Item coverage
coverage.summary: confirmed {{confirmed, number}} of {{total, number}} · to clarify {{toClarify, number}} · no data {{missing, number}}
coverage.legend: Confirmed means an offer or a registry record that meets the requirements. Other states need clarification and are never added to the confirmed count.
coverage.conditions: Quantity, delivery dates, delivery region and payment terms are not checked against sources — clarify them with the supplier.
